QuestInfo.name: The Wailing White Fang
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2030001##k seems to have something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate the White Fang and report to #bCassandra#k. \n\n#o5140000# #r#a98451##k
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the White Fang that was wailing loudly.

0.0: Soldier! What are you doing in my district? Never mind, that doesn't really matter. Since you are here, please do me a favor.

yes.0: Do you see all the White Fangs around here? #bCassandra#k says that the cries of these wolves have given her insomnia. Defeat #r100#k of these #rWhite Fangs#k and deliver the news to Cassandra immediately.

no.0: How can you so easily refuse the request of Sergeant Bravo?

npc.0: Your mission is the eliminate #r100 White Fangs#k and deliver the news to #bCassandra#k. Snap to it!

mob.0: I can't sleep because of all the noise the wolves are making. Please eliminate about #r100 White Fangs#k.
